turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I know who you are. I have about twenty minutes, so tell me why Owen has a zero.
Go ahead, Hale. I'm writing it down. Start with who decided on the zero.
I have 140 students. I don't have time to be cross-examined by every parent with a law degree.
"Cross-examined." I asked you one question, Hale. Owen is one of your 140, and he found out about his zero on his phone, in class.
You don't get to talk to me like I'm on the stand.
You're not on the stand, Hale. You entered a zero on Tuesday, November 3, and I'm asking what it rests on. I have until 4:40.
